game: Jade Cocoon: Story of the Tamamayu
approach: Engine reimplementation in Rust on Bevy: reads the game's data tables and interprets its scene scripts, no native code run
notes: The story plays through its ending: battles, capture and merging, menus, movies, music, voices, saves and the second-round corridor. 1.1 adds PC options (widescreen, gamepads, rebinding, fast-forward, quick saves) and a two-player Arena Battle over LAN or the internet; 1.1.1 adds an Android build. Never runs the original PlayStation machine code. Game files are not included: you need your own original copy of the European release.
